description: The KRID research team publishes annotated images of road infrastructure across South Korea. Nine survey vehicles acquired more than two million high-resolution frames; the curated set contains 200,000 annotated frames and 2,676,583 instances across thirty-four facility types. The GitHub repository documents a public 480 MB sample with bounding boxes, polygons and JSON annotations. Full data require a separate form and approval. The repository states a CC BY-NC-SA licence but does not name its version. Access to the sample is free. These images can calibrate road-asset recognition or validate maintenance scenarios in road simulations. The sample may not represent all asset classes or provinces, and the full dataset was not accessed. File contents were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Korean Road Infrastructure Dataset KRID
notes: G4-0497; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
